messages:
Maya (Product): Short sync: customer asked for a prefetch pilot with short high-QPS bursts + HSM-backed keys. Need cross-team sequencing, owners, and launch gates.
Jin (Eng): We can route bursts but runtime needs async batching + KV-cache tuning. Priya: how much effort?
Priya (Runtime): Async batcher + cache-policy toggles ~2 sprints (2 engs). Also need a harness to emulate long-tail sequence lengths. Need a canary pool for validation.
Alex (Infra): Canary pool fine. Infra work: reserve capacity, autoscale policy changes, and VPC routing for HSM/KMS traffic. Estimate ~7 dev-days incl tests. Need expected sustained vs burst QPS to size.
Sam (Security): HSM options: cloud KMS with HSM-backed keys (faster) or on-prem HSM (adds compliance + network DMZ). I'll draft threat model and checklist; auditor availability could be a blocker.
Maya (Product): Proposed gates: 1) customer acceptance tests pass; 2) p50 <=150ms for 512 tokens on dedicated pool; 3) automatic fallback to hosted-compatible model variant under capacity loss; 4) security signoff for keys. Thoughts?
Jin (Eng): Add perf-regression suite in CI and a chaos test that simulates pool outage to validate fallback. Also document quantization vs quality tradeoffs in the spec.
Priya (Runtime): Agree. We'll implement canary routing and a per-tenant model-pin flag. Request a small canary slice from infra before broad rollout.
Alex (Infra): Opening INFRA ticket now. Action: product -> send target sustained RPS and burst QPS by EOD so we can size. infra-bot: INFRA-7991 created (reserved window 2024-10-01..2024-10-10)
Nora (PMM): Customer expects SLA language. For pilot label as "pilot SLO" and clearly state capacity boundaries. Marketing will align comms after roadmap update.
Maya (Product): Action owners: Jin -> perf test + CI gating; Priya -> runtime fallback/canary design; Alex -> infra ticket & autoscale runbook; Sam -> HSM checklist & threat model; Nora -> comms draft. Reconvene next Tue 11am.
Jin (Eng): Quick repro command: `./run_perf --model prefetch-pilot-v2 --tokens 512 --concurrency 8 --dur 60s`
Priya (Runtime): Note: include one quantized and one FP16 variant in tests to measure latency vs quality.
Sam (Security): If HSM audit stalls, fallback: customer-managed KMS + audit logging + accelerated key rotation. I'll post checklist.
Maya (Product): Thanks team 44d tracking in roadmap card.
